title: Machine Games Duty: changes to stake and prize thresholds
text:
This measure will amend the stake and prize thresholds used to determine the rates of Machine Games Duty.

 From 1 April 2027, dutiable gaming machines will be subject to the higher rate of 25% if either the maximum:

 • charge to play is more than £1

 • prize is more than £100

 These machines are currently subject to the standard rate of 20%.
